task_description: Implement every committed fix F1-F12 from design.md: make one Windows machine run a full worship service end-to-end OFFLINE with no crashes. Priority-1 offline reliability only, behavior-preserving unless the current behavior is a bug. Add the required cross-platform xUnit tests in WorshipPlayer.Tests (net8.0, Core-referenced; no WPF/ASP.NET hosting). Baseline: build 0 errors / 4 pre-existing warnings, 411 tests green; after: 0 errors, no new warnings, all tests green.
